content.description: Full structure: car, violating car, 3 moto types (regular, slow, space-seeker) and illegal-left riders; rules for early start, swarm, space seeking, box waiting, slow centre riding.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car discharge headway (0.35 s observed): shorter tau and higher accel shorten the headway; low impatience keeps car red running near 0.004 (M3/share/car).
Small violating-car group that may take the continuous right-turn lane when the queue is long; targets M9a (0.57 straight vehicles per cycle in the right-turn lane) and M9b.
Regular riders: low tau/minGap and compact alignment give the short discharge headway (M1/moto 0.30 s) and stop-line overshoot (M4/overshoot_share 0.62, overshoot_depth 2 m).
Own slow archetype (behaviour 10): lower speedFactor and speedDev lengthen approach times (M6/approach s/l/u moto) in the lane centre.

Space-seeking, lateral-filtering riders: small minGapLat, high lcSublane and lcPushy 0.5 and arbitrary alignment raise M8/moto wrong-lane share (0.25) and lateral position (M4/lat_moto); they carry the sidewalk and wrong-lane options (F2).
Illegal-left riders from HDT_N/HDT_S: small jmTimegapMinor and minGap let them accept gaps and turn when the opposing green ends, targeting M7a/M7b/M6 junction illegal_l.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto is 0.13 over the last 10 s of red; p 0.2 per front-row rider with 8 s window creeping at 2.5 m/s reproduces it and shortens M2/first_delay.
Cars rarely leave early (M2/early/car 0.011), so a small p and short window; the custom2 car_seeker is not eligible for early_start.
M3/share/moto is 0.098 and M3/var_to_mean 1.14 (near-Poisson): modest p0 with weak group effect keeps per-cycle red runs around 3.9 without inflating variance.
Observed queues are short (M5/length 15.8 m), so trigger at 10 m; probabilities follow the observed wrong_lane 0.19-0.23, right_lane 0.01-0.02 and sidewalk 0.01-0.05 shares (M10a, M9a).
M7a release_time is 2.78 s after the opposing green end; a 1 s extra hold above SUMO native release moves box exit and M7b clear lag toward observation.
Slow riders keep near the lane centre (small offset) so they obstruct faster riders slightly, supporting long M6 approach times.

reasoning: Removed lcPushyGap from moto_seeker (kept lcPushy 0.5) because SUMO ignores lcPushyGap when lcPushy is set. Removed car_seeker (custom2) from the car early_start rule's applies_to since early_start only supports passenger, motorcycle and custom1; the rule now applies to car_normal only. Everything else is unchanged, and shares still sum to 1 per distribution.
